text:
Which statement about electroplating a copper spoon with silver is correct?
A
Both the anode and cathode are made of carbon.
B
The copper spoon is the anode.
Aqueous copper(II) sulfate is the electrolyte.
C
D
Silver is formed at the negative electrode.

options.label: A
options.text: Both the anode and cathode are made of carbon.

options.label: B
options.text: The copper spoon is the anode.

options.label: C
options.text: Aqueous copper(II) sulfate is the electrolyte.

options.label: D
options.text: Silver is formed at the negative electrode.
